name: Iryna Gurevych

affiliations.role: Founder and head, Professor at TU Darmstadt

bio: Iryna Gurevych is a Professor of Computer Science at TU Darmstadt and director of the Ubiquitous Knowledge Processing (UKP) Lab, and was president of the Association for Computational Linguistics in 2023. Their research covers NLP and machine learning, including large language models and AI safety. Gurevych co-developed Sentence-BERT with Nils Reimers and the AdapterHub framework.
known_for: Directs the UKP Lab at TU Darmstadt
